# Legal Shaman

> UK legal navigation. Not a solicitor. Not legal advice.

We do not give legal advice, recommend a named solicitor as counsel, or assess a case. Matches come from stored register data.

## Routes

- [Find a lawyer](https://www.legalshaman.com/find-a-lawyer): Canonical matcher (redirects to `/ask-the-shaman?guided=1`).
- [Signpost](https://www.legalshaman.com/signposting): Free help, legal aid, and national resources by area of law.
- [For firms](https://www.legalshaman.com/for-firms): Overflow routing for UK practices and advice agencies.
- [Embed install](https://www.legalshaman.com/embed/install): Paste-ready Signpost iframe.

Sitemap: https://www.legalshaman.com/sitemap.xml
